ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AC$ is the diagonal of rhombus $ABCD$. If $\angle ABC = 60^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle CAD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus,\\
$AB=BC=CD=AD$, and $AD\parallel BC$,\\
since $\angle ABC=60^\circ$,\\
then $\triangle ABC$ is an equilateral triangle, i.e., $\angle ACB = \angle CAB = 60^\circ$,\\
since $AD\parallel BC$,\\
then $\angle CAD=\angle ACB=60^\circ$.\\
Therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{60^\circ}$.
